meta.note: Source 1-SOURCES/Translations/en-Padmakara_2006.md was never edited. Both benchmark files live outside 1-SOURCES/. Commentary used throughout: BCAC20_NKW only. IMPORTANT: the raw en-Padmakara_2006.md file labels one further quatrain '^3-34' ("And so, today, within the sight of all protectors...") before the Chapter 4 heading; per the task scope (chapter 3 = 33 verses) this benchmark excludes that block entirely — both baseline and test files stop at ^3-33. Also note: extract_commentary.py's transclusion-marker splitting exhibits a one-verse cascading shift in nkw_commentary.json starting partway through verse 3-2/3-3 (a root-verse couplet is quoted at the tail of one bucket while its own explanation appears at the head of the next-labeled bucket, and from there every JSON key 3-N (N>=4) actually holds the commentary for ENGLISH verse N+1). All anchors/glosses in this answer key were built from the semantically-correct verse content (cross-checked against the Tibetan root-verse quotations), not from naive JSON-key equality. The clean-audit report must document this shift explicitly, per the skill's own cascading-shift instruction.

items.anchor_bo: བྱང་ཆུབ་སྐུ་གསུམ་ཡེ་ཤེས་ཡོན་ཏན (byang chub sku gsum ye shes yon tan)
items.commentary_gloss: the ultimate fruit of the completely perfect Buddhas: enlightenment endowed with the THREE KĀYAS (sku gsum) and wisdom-qualities — sku = body/kāya, not mind
items.original: the Buddhahood of the protectors
items.injected: the wisdom-mind of the protectors

items.commentary_gloss: THIS BODY (lus) is what has been given for beings to use as they please — repeated explicitly; lus = physical body, not mind
items.original: This body I have now resigned
items.injected: This mind I have now resigned

items.commentary_gloss: the moon of MIND (sems) risen from within the mindstream, dispelling the heat of afflictions in the mind — sems = mind, not body
items.original: the rising moon of the enlightened mind
items.injected: the rising moon of the enlightened body

items.anchor_bo: བྱང་ཆུབ་ཐོབ་པའི་རྒྱུར་གྱུར་པའི་དགེ་བ (byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i dge ba)
items.commentary_gloss: virtue that is the cause of attaining ENLIGHTENMENT/liberation (byang chub) — specifically the śrāvaka/pratyekabuddha fruit of arhatship — a technical liberation attainment, not a vague 'better rebirth' within saṃsāra
items.original: cause of gaining the enlightened state
items.injected: cause of gaining a better rebirth

items.commentary_gloss: the formal bodhisattva TRAININGS/precepts — explicitly the three-tiered vow-classes (restraint / virtue-gathering / benefiting-beings precepts) the commentary details at length here — a formal doctrinal category, not vague 'habits'
items.original: and in those precepts, step-by-step, I will abide and train myself
items.injected: and in those habits, step-by-step, I will abide and train myself

items.commentary_gloss: an INEXHAUSTIBLE/never-ending treasure of resources — mi zad pa = literally endless, not merely occasional
items.original: may I become a treasure ever-plentiful
items.injected: may I become a treasure sometimes plentiful

items.anchor_bo: བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའི་བསླབ་པ (byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa)
items.commentary_gloss: the BODHISATTVA precepts specifically — the commentary explicitly contrasts this with the śrāvaka vow-taking system, which it says 'does not exist nowadays' (de'i lugs deng sang med)
items.original: and in the precepts of the Bodhisattvas step-by-step abode and trained,
items.injected: and in the precepts of the Śrāvakas step-by-step abode and trained,

items.commentary_gloss: ALL beings (thams cad) — the mind that wishes to place ALL beings, without exception, in the state of happiness
items.original: that seeks to place all beings in the state of bliss
items.injected: that seeks to place some beings in the state of bliss

items.commentary_gloss: for many COUNTLESS great eons (bskal pa bskal chen grangs med pa du ma) — an explicitly innumerable span, not a finite hundred
items.original: stay among us for unnumbered ages!
items.injected: stay among us for a hundred ages!

items.anchor_bo: མཁའ་ཁྱབ་ཀྱི་སེམས་ཅན་ཐམས་ཅད (mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad)
items.commentary_gloss: ALL beings pervading the whole of space (mkha' khyab, thams cad) — a universal, boundless scope, not merely 'many'
items.original: may all the pain of every living being be wholly scattered and destroyed!
items.injected: may all the pain of many a living being be wholly scattered and destroyed!

items.anchor_bo: སེམས་ཅན་གྲངས་མེད་པ་དཔག་ཏུ་མེད་པ (sems can grangs med pa dpag tu med pa)
items.commentary_gloss: COUNTLESS, IMMEASURABLE beings — an explicitly infinite/unbounded scope, not merely 'many'
items.original: for boundless multitudes of beings
items.injected: for many multitudes of beings

items.commentary_gloss: reaching to the very LIMITS OF SPACE — an explicitly boundless/infinite scope, not a bounded visual range
items.original: as far as are the limits of the sky
items.injected: as far as the eye can see

items.anchor_bo: ཉོན་མོངས་པ་བརྒྱད་ཁྲི་བཞི་སྟོང་ཐམས་ཅད (nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad)
items.commentary_gloss: cures ALL 84,000 kinds of affliction — an explicit total count reinforcing thams cad ('all'), not merely 'most'
items.original: It is the sovereign remedy that perfectly allays all maladies.
items.injected: It is the sovereign remedy that perfectly allays most maladies.

items.anchor_bo: དེ་དག་གི་ཡིད་ལ་བསམ་པའི་དོན (de dag gi yid la bsam pa'i don)
items.commentary_gloss: THEIR OWN aims/wishes are what get fulfilled by this cause — the beneficiary is the other being (dgra gnyen/sems can), not the speaker
items.original: may these states always be the cause whereby their good and wishes are fulfilled
items.injected: may these states always be the cause whereby my good and wishes are fulfilled

items.anchor_bo: དེ་ཐམས་ཅད་བླ་ན་མེད་པ་རྫོགས་པའི་བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་སྐལ་བ་དང་ལྡན་པར་གྱུར་ཅིག (de thams cad byang chub kyi skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig)
items.commentary_gloss: may ALL THOSE [aggressors/harmers] become endowed with the fortune of enlightenment — the beneficiary is explicitly the offending others, not the speaker
items.original: may they attain the fortune of enlightenment!
items.injected: may I attain the fortune of enlightenment!

items.commentary_gloss: [bodhicitta] itself is what DESTROYS/slays the Lord of Death — bodhicitta is the agent of destruction, not its victim
items.original: This is the supreme draft of immortality that slays the Lord of Death, the slaughterer of beings,
items.injected: This is the supreme draft of immortality that is slain by the Lord of Death, the slaughterer of beings,

items.anchor_bo: གྲུ་དང་གཟིངས་དང་ཟམ་པ (gru dang gzings dang zam pa)
items.commentary_gloss: fixed order: boat (gru), then raft (gzings), then bridge (zam pa), for beings wishing to cross a great river or ocean
items.original: may I be a boat, a raft, a bridge.
items.injected: may I be a bridge, a raft, a boat.

items.commentary_gloss: fixed sequence in the commentary: island first (for those lost at sea craving land), THEN lamp (for those in darkness)
items.original: May I be an isle for those who yearn for land, a lamp for those who long for light;
items.injected: May I be a lamp for those who long for light, an isle for those who yearn for land;

items.commentary_gloss: a heap of filthy roadside SWEEPINGS/RUBBISH — explicitly worthless refuse (symbolizing the practitioner's own afflictions); the simile depends on the contrast between worthless filth and a precious jewel, not a heap of already-valuable gold
items.original: who has found a precious gem inside a heap of dust
items.injected: who has found a precious gem inside a heap of gold

items.commentary_gloss: the milk of the HOLY DHARMA/teaching (heard, contemplated, meditated upon) — explicitly what gets churned into the butter of realization, not literal milk from any wish-granting animal
items.original: the creamy butter, rich and full, that’s churned from milk of holy teaching.
items.injected: the creamy butter, rich and full, that’s churned from the milk of the wish-granting cow.
